### F-05: Empty input boundaries remain too faint in account forms; birth fields repaired

P2 · observed · **implemented**

Where: src/components/pattern/BirthDetailsForm.tsx:23 and :449; src/styles.css --input in light/dark themes; src/routes/auth.tsx:105,124; src/components/pattern/AccountSecurity.tsx:191,205,221; src/components/pattern/AccountLink.tsx:99 at 10c87a18da4ed8ef24e757108ecc3b0c19b98d3f. Expected: Enabled empty manual fields remain visually identifiable without relying on current value, focus, hover or placeholder text; required boundary/fill reaches 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11).. Actual: After clearing manual Latitude and blurring it, border-to-fill is 1.3934:1 light and 1.7864:1 dark; border-to-surround is 1.3263:1 and 1.7439:1. Fill-to-surround is only 1.0506:1 and 1.1100:1. Empty Latitude/Longitude have no placeholder or icon that identifies their editable bounds. A focused Timezone ring passes, but does not identify the other unfocused empty fields. Current account inputs reproduce border-to-fill 1.393352:1 light and 1.786369:1 dark; border-to-surround 1.326298:1 / 1.743893:1; fill-to-surround 1.050557:1 / 1.110026:1. All measured fields were empty, enabled and unfocused, with no inside placeholder/icon..
Cause: The shared birth inputClass uses low-contrast border-input and a card fill close to the surrounding surface.. Disposition reason: 

Affected scope, retained evidence, fix and history:

### F-06: Signed coordinate fields request a keypad that may omit minus

P2 · code_supported · **implemented**

Where: src/components/pattern/BirthDetailsForm.tsx:451; src/lib/birth-form.ts:60 and :84. Expected: The manual path supports accepted negative coordinates without needing geocoding, a hardware keyboard or clipboard workaround.. Actual: Latitude and Longitude request inputMode=decimal while validation accepts negative decimal values. Current MDN documents that decimal keyboards may omit minus. Programmatic -33.8688/-151.2093 entry succeeds in both proxies; no physical-keyboard failure is claimed..
Cause: Keyboard hint is narrower than the accepted signed input on some potential target keyboard configurations; exact affected device/keyboard versions need acquisition.. Disposition reason:

Setup: Open https://nvidia-romance-pod-extras.trycloudflare.com/__preview on the named phone/browser. Check build B-PHONE-ACCOUNT-20261021T040046Z at /__preview/manifest and /__preview/health. Source is base 10c87a1 plus uncommitted account fix and retained pre-existing changes; hashes are in the manifest. Use synthetic data only. This browser gets an isolated test account automatically; reset it from preview controls. The backend is local test HTTP/file storage; production auth/email/password, Stripe, AI writing and Swiss services are disconnected. Theme selection, pending/fail/lost-ack controls and canonical saved test records are at /__preview. Record actual hardware, OS/browser, Safari tab layout, CSS width, keyboard/locale, build and setup separately.

Steps:
1. Open the preview control page, confirm the displayed build and isolated-backend identity, and reset a test account. Record actual device/browser/OS/viewport/keyboard. Use synthetic data only.
2. At the narrowest supported phone width available, record actual CSS width; read Today, select Mood 4 and Energy 3 using visible labels, enter a Unicode/multiline reflection, and verify each selected value. Repeat the selection in three fresh states; report each trial.
3. Open/close the software keyboard, expand/collapse browser chrome, rotate portrait to short landscape, then repeat with 200% text/page enlargement. Check focus visibility, note/submit reachability, safe-area clearance and pinch zoom; report each state independently.
4. Scroll a short note and an overflowing note at both ends; navigate Today → Journal → Today and compare draft values. Save only against the confirmed test backend; verify the canonical record returned after navigation.
5. On both /birth and /onboarding, open Enter coordinates manually. With the default software keyboard, type ASCII -33.8688 / -151.2093, +90 / +180, -90 / -180, 0 / -0 and leading-zero decimals; paste signed decimals too. Record keyboard/locale and access to minus, plus and decimal point. Verify range errors for91/181 and correct them. Check IANA timezone slashes, date/time, next/done keys, and draft recovery after reload. Save once only against the confirmed test backend and inspect returned canonical coordinates. Repeat portrait/short landscape, keyboard open/closed, expanded/collapsed chrome, narrowest supported available width (record actual CSS width) and200% enlargement; report each portion.
6. Open and close the menu, test Back/Forward separately from native edge gestures, and open/collapse/reopen a Pattern chapter. Record reach/regrips/missed taps for one-thumb, two-thumb and cradled grips.
7. For F-04/F-05, inspect all four selected accuracy helpers and empty/unfocused, focused and invalid birth inputs in both supported theme states if the build exposes them. Text and boundaries must stay legible, focus visible and radio labels operable. Capture screenshots; do not infer quantitative contrast from visual inspection alone.
8. On /auth (signin, signup, reset), /privacy (Change email/password) and the test reset-password link, leave all fields empty and unfocused. Inspect boundaries in light and explicit .dark; compare with /birth. If no theme switch exists, activate .dark through Web Inspector/Chrome remote debugging on the test build and record that setup. If unavailable, leave dark not run. Use resolved sRGB colors/alpha compositing through the inspector or a screenshot contrast tool, and report method and ratios; visual inspection alone does not establish 3:1. Current account boundaries are known to fail until the proposed patch is actually applied. Report each state independently.
9. Account writes: email/password/reset-link submissions intentionally return unsupported test errors; test native field entry, focus, pending/error and input preservation only. Do not claim a real email, password change or production session result. Preview sign-in is synthetic.

Expected: Signed coordinates, leading signs, decimals and IANA timezone text remain enterable and preserve existing validation/save/draft behavior. Full text keyboard remains usable across the stated browser UI/keyboard/orientation/enlargement states. Corrected selected help and empty boundaries remain distinguishable, with visible focus and no page overflow. Confirm the actual canonical test record before claiming a save. Empty enabled account fields should be visually identifiable at >=3:1 for the required boundary; the patched account boundaries meet the measured threshold locally; record the phone result independently.

3. Open/close the software keyboard, expand/collapse browser chrome, rotate portrait to short landscape, then repeat with 200% text/page enlargement. Check focus visibility, note/submit reachability, safe-area clearance and pinch zoom; report each state independently.
4. Scroll a short note and an overflowing note at both ends; navigate Today → Journal → Today and compare draft values. Save only against the confirmed test backend; verify the canonical record returned after navigation.
5. On both /birth and /onboarding, open Enter coordinates manually. With the default software keyboard, type ASCII -33.8688 / -151.2093, +90 / +180, -90 / -180, 0 / -0 and leading-zero decimals; paste signed decimals too. Record keyboard/locale and access to minus, plus and decimal point. Verify range errors for91/181 and correct them. Check IANA timezone slashes, date/time, next/done keys, and draft recovery after reload. Save once only against the confirmed test backend and inspect returned canonical coordinates. Repeat portrait/short landscape, keyboard open/closed, expanded/collapsed chrome, narrowest supported available width (record actual CSS width) and200% enlargement; report each portion.
6. Open and close the menu, test Back/Forward separately from native edge gestures, and open/collapse/reopen a Pattern chapter. Record reach/regrips/missed taps for one-thumb, two-thumb and cradled grips.
7. With the menu open press Android system Back; verify it dismisses the overlay without an extra page traversal. Distinguish this from desktop history navigation. Expand/collapse Chrome bottom chin and inspect gesture-bar clearance.
8. For F-04/F-05, inspect all four selected accuracy helpers and empty/unfocused, focused and invalid birth inputs in both supported theme states if the build exposes them. Text and boundaries must stay legible, focus visible and radio labels operable. Capture screenshots; do not infer quantitative contrast from visual inspection alone.
9. On /auth (signin, signup, reset), /privacy (Change email/password) and the test reset-password link, leave all fields empty and unfocused. Inspect boundaries in light and explicit .dark; compare with /birth. If no theme switch exists, activate .dark through Web Inspector/Chrome remote debugging on the test build and record that setup. If unavailable, leave dark not run. Use resolved sRGB colors/alpha compositing through the inspector or a screenshot contrast tool, and report method and ratios; visual inspection alone does not establish 3:1. Current account boundaries are known to fail until the proposed patch is actually applied. Report each state independently.
10. Account writes: email/password/reset-link submissions intentionally return unsupported test errors; test native field entry, focus, pending/error and input preservation only. Do not claim a real email, password change or production session result. Preview sign-in is synthetic.

Expected: Signed coordinates, leading signs, decimals and IANA timezone text remain enterable and preserve existing validation/save/draft behavior.
